messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, ché la diritta via era smarrita.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + definite article “in the” (location) | **ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ** | “in the middle” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun “midway, middle” | **ಮಧ್ಯ** | “middle” | OK | | **del** | genitive “of the” linking “mezzo” to “cammin” | **ದ** | “of” | OK | | **cammin** | noun “road, journey” | **ಮಾರ್ಗ** | “road” | OK | | **di** | preposition “of” linking to “nostra vita” | **ದ** | “of” | OK | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **ನಮ್ಮ** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” | **ಜೀವನ** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” (object of ritrovai) | **ನನ್ನನ್ನು** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | verb “found” (past remote) | **ಕಂಡೆ** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition “within/through” (spatial) | **ನಲ್ಲಿ** | “in” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” (non‑specific) | — | — | **MISSING** | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **ಕಾಡು** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” (metaphoric) | **ಕತ್ತಲೆ** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for, because” (causal) | — | — | **MISSING** | | **la** | definite article “the” (specifies way) | — | — | **MISSING** | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight, correct” | **ಸರಿಯಾದ** | “right/correct” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **ಮಾರ್ಗ** | “way” | OK | | **era** | verb “was” (imperfect of *essere*) | **ಇತ್ತು** | “was” | OK | | **smarrita** | past participle “missed, lost” | **ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು** | “had been missed / was lost” | OK |
---
### Items Needing Attention - **una** – no direct article in Kannada; the translation omits it. - **ché** – causal conjunction omitted; the Kannada clause stands alone. - **la** – definite article not expressed in Kannada; omitted.
All other lexical correspondences are correctly rendered with appropriate grammatical agreement.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಾರ್ಗದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ - Issue: none - Corrected: ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಾರ್ಗದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ
- Line 2: - Original: ನಾನು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಕಂಡೆ, - Issue: missing indefinite article “ಒಂದು” - Corrected: ನಾನು ಒಂದು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಕಂಡೆ,
- Line 3: - Original: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು. - Issue: missing conjunction “ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ” and definite article “ಆ” - Corrected: ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು.
```kannada ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮಾರ್ಗದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾನು ಒಂದು ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಕಂಡೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು. ```
